column1: # Maxwell (SM52) instruction formats inferred from disassembler answers to
# bit flips of known words. model sha256 32b7ce2e67de28a55125e4d047f5b30e1ed3e7a1259ce26b96f134f0c6a9b2c3
# 7117 variants over 328 rows; 3671318 held words rendered, 3549750 exactly.
# Bits: parts hi:lo in value order, least significant part first, comma-joined.
# Texts: \R \P \N mark register, predicate and number atoms in an operand shape;
#   in a variant template each carries its value: \R5; \P7; \Nx-16; (hex) \Nd3; (decimal) \F1.5; (float).
# Keys: selector and register bits joined by | (nz:bits counts only zero 0 or not 1; - no
#   key); entries value=result with the key values comma-joined; *=result for key values
#   never seen (none: the rule says nothing there).
# zero    row text                        how [RZ+0x0] prints in this row
# order   row a b count                   modifier a printed before b this often
# order-other row a b count               the same over rows printing the mnemonic, for pairs
# omit    row operand shape count value   in a text of count operands, operand (of shape) is
#                                         left out when its one atom is value (RZ 255, PT 7)
# flag    row slot shape bit shape        flipping bit turns operand slot's shape into the next
# field   row form index role bits ...
#   reg   file slot xor [slot...]         printed xor xor at the first slot, and again at each other
#   imm   slot scale bias sign            value = sum of set bits' weights (scale <<s: bit k weighs
#                                         2^(k+s); w:e,e,..: bit k weighs 2^e_k), the top bit negative
#                                         when sign is twos, negated when its neg rule says 1, plus bias
#   float slot encoding                   [-]W<<s: the field is bits s up of a W-bit IEEE float (s < 0:
#                                         the field's bits from -s up); - flips the sign bit
#   mod   tokens value=names...;  flag slot;  none
#   fixed-* ...                           part of the variant mask (fixed-enum: slot value=shape...)
# rule    row form index kind key entries  a rule of field index: sign (twos|plain; else the field's),
#                                         neg (1 negates; else 0), enc (encoding; else the field's),
# derive  row form index slot key entries  register atom slot prints field index's value plus
#                                         the entry, or the zero register (Z), or itself (no entry)
# render  row form slot key value=shape... operand shape decided by selector values
# token   row form name key value=0|1...  a modifier no field owns, printed where the key says 1
# refuse  row form key value=ok|bad...    words the disassembler rejects (bad): no variant prints them
# refuse-alone row form k value=ok|bad... key values never seen: component k's values that decide
#                                         alone; two disagreeing give the refuse fallback
# refuse-rest row form ok|bad             ... and when no component decides
# variant id row form mask value base samples exact glued|spaced mnemonic mods guard operands...
